title: Shopper can sign in, build a cart and complete checkout
context: As a shopper, I want to sign in, add products to my cart and complete checkout, so that I can buy products online. Web shop UI only (the AUT profile has no API origin).

sourcesRead.contributes: user story, AC-1..AC-9, notes (test accounts, pricing owner, out of scope)
display, item total, tax, total and shipping rules (R1-R6) used by AC-7
test accounts: standard_user and locked_out_user, password secret_sauce

acceptanceCriteria.text: A registered shopper who signs in with valid credentials lands on the "Products" page, which lists the full catalogue of 6 products.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: A registered shopper who signs in with valid credentials lands on the "Products" page, which lists the full catalogue of 6 products.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: sign-in page (AUT base URL, see G1); sign in as standard_user / secret_sauce (test-users.csv)
outcomes: after signing in the "Products" page is shown
the Products page lists 6 products (the full catalogue)

acceptanceCriteria.text: A shopper whose account is locked cannot sign in. The error message "Your account has been locked. Please contact customer support." is shown and the shopper stays on the sign-in page.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: A shopper whose account is locked cannot sign in. The error message "Your account has been locked. Please contact customer support." is shown and the shopper stays on the sign-in page.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: sign-in page (AUT base URL, see G1); sign in as locked_out_user / secret_sauce (test-users.csv)
outcomes: the locked shopper is not signed in
error message "Your account has been locked. Please contact customer support." is shown
the shopper stays on the sign-in page

acceptanceCriteria.text: When the password is wrong, the error "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown and, for security, both the Username and Password fields are cleared.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: When the password is wrong, the error "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown and, for security, both the Username and Password fields are cleared.

outcomes: error "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown
the Username field is cleared (empty)
the Password field is cleared (empty)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The shopper can sort products by "Price (low to high)"; products are then displayed in ascending order of price.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: The shopper can sort products by "Price (low to high)"; products are then displayed in ascending order of price.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: Products page after signing in as standard_user
outcomes: sorting by "Price (low to high)" is available
after sorting, the displayed products are in ascending order of price (each price is not lower than the one before it)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart badge count by one; removing it decreases the count, and the badge is not shown when the cart is empty.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart badge count by one; removing it decreases the count, and the badge is not shown when the cart is empty.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: Products page after signing in as standard_user, with an empty cart
outcomes: each product added increases the cart badge count by one
removing a product decreases the cart badge count
the cart badge is not shown when the cart is empty

acceptanceCriteria.text: At checkout, First Name, Last Name and Postal Code are mandatory. Continuing without a First Name shows "Error: First Name is required".
acceptanceCriteria.quote: At checkout, First Name, Last Name and Postal Code are mandatory. Continuing without a First Name shows "Error: First Name is required".
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: checkout information step: sign in as standard_user, add a product, open the cart, Checkout
outcomes: continuing without a First Name shows "Error: First Name is required"
checkout does not continue past the information step while First Name, Last Name or Postal Code is missing

acceptanceCriteria.text: The checkout overview shows the Item total, Tax and Total. Item total is the sum of the prices of the items in the cart; Tax is calculated according to the attached pricing-rules.md; Total = Item total + Tax.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: The checkout overview shows the Item total, Tax and Total. Item total is the sum of the prices of the items in the cart; Tax is calculated according to the attached `pricing-rules.md`; Total = Item total + Tax.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: checkout overview: sign in as standard_user, add products, cart, Checkout, fill the information step, Continue
outcomes: the overview shows Item total, Tax and Total
Item total = sum of the unit prices of the items in the cart (quantity 1 per product)
Tax = 10% of the item total, rounded half-up to 2 decimals
Total = Item total + Tax, shown with two decimals; no shipping is added
amounts are shown in USD with two decimals, prefixed with $

acceptanceCriteria.text: Finishing the order shows the confirmation "Thank you for your order!" and the cart is empty afterwards.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: Finishing the order shows the confirmation "Thank you for your order!" and the cart is empty afterwards.
outcomes: confirmation "Thank you for your order!" is shown
the cart is empty afterwards

acceptanceCriteria.text: Logging out returns the shopper to the sign-in page, and protected pages (e.g. the Products page URL) can no longer be opened without signing in again.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: Logging out returns the shopper to the sign-in page, and protected pages (e.g. the Products page URL) can no longer be opened without signing in again.
acceptanceCriteria.entryPoint: Products page after signing in as standard_user; log out from the menu
outcomes: after logging out the shopper is on the sign-in page
opening the Products page URL after logging out does not show the Products page until the shopper signs in again

rules.text: All prices are shown in USD with two decimals, prefixed with $ (e.g. $29.99).
Item total = sum of the unit prices of every item in the cart (quantity 1 per product).
Sales tax is 10% of the item total.
Tax is rounded half-up to 2 decimals.
Total = Item total + Tax, shown with two decimals.
Shipping is free for all orders and is not added to the total.

errorModel.body: Your account has been locked. Please contact customer support.
Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

errorModel.case: checkout information step continued without a First Name (AC-6)

auth.mechanism: UI sign-in form (username + password); logout from the menu
auth.credentials: attachments/test-users.csv: standard_user / secret_sauce (happy path), locked_out_user / secret_sauce (locked)

testData.strategy: No seeding: the accounts pre-exist (test-users.csv) and the cart is built through the UI in each test. Each test starts from a fresh browser session (empty cart).
constraints: AC-3: username standard_user with any password other than secret_sauce
AC-7: put at least two different products in the cart (quantity 1 each) so the item total is a real sum
testData.cleanup: none needed (no persistent data is created; the cart lives in the browser session)
